title: Small AL quiz
summary: A quiz about AL code demonstrates how StrSubstNo formats decimal numbers with thousands separators in some regions, causing runtime errors in CalcDate date formulas. The post shows how to avoid this by using integers instead of decimals.
key_points: StrSubstNo formats decimal numbers using Format(Number, 0), which adds thousands separators based on region settings
CalcDate requires date formulas without separators, so formatted decimals like '1,000D' cause runtime errors
Using integers instead of decimals avoids the thousands separator issue
Region settings affect how numbers are formatted in AL code
